title: Trajectory-Level Security Debt in LLM Coding Agents
title_zh: 轨迹级安全债务在LLM编码代理中的度量方法

paragraphs.en: LLM coding agents can traverse hundreds of intermediate code states before submitting a solution. Evaluating only the final artifact leaves the evolution of security findings unmeasured. We introduce the Security Debt Line Integral (SDLI), which accumulates static-analysis risk when an agent reaches a new best test pass ratio. We instantiate it with four static application security testing (SAST) tools and study artifacts from 830 passing SWE-bench runs, 712 ProgramBench final workspaces, and 13 public MirrorCode trajectories. The two large populations use the final-state special case of SDLI. Two-tool Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) class agreement occurs in 3.9% of SWE-bench runs and 26.2% of the 80 ProgramBench runs passing at least 90% of official tests. These are scanner findings, not validated vulnerability rates. Excluding three advisory-heavy classes reduces the latter rate to 6.2%. Same-task runs differ in their measured scores, while one reconstructed ProgramBench run exposes persistent findings from its first implementation write. A repair case study reduces the scanner signal while preserving tested behavior, but also reveals sensitivity to equivalent API rewrites. SDLI offers a way to study progress and security findings together. Its value for steering agents and confirming exploitable vulnerabilities remains to be established.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 编码智能体在提交解决方案之前，可能会遍历数百种中间代码状态。 仅评估最终产物，会导致安全发现点的演变过程无法被衡量。 我们提出了“安全债务线积分”（Security Debt Line Integral, SDLI），当智能体达到新的最佳测试通过率时，它会累积静态分析风险。 我们使用四种静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具对其进行了具体实现，并研究了来自 830 次通过 SWE-bench 的运行、712 个 ProgramBench 最终工作区以及 13 条公开 MirrorCode 轨迹的产物。 这两个大规模数据集均使用了 SDLI 的最终状态特例。 在 SWE-bench 的运行中，两种工具对通用弱点枚举（CWE）类别的一致性出现率为 3.9%；而在至少通过 90% 官方测试的 80 次 ProgramBench 运行中，该比率则为 26.2%。 这些是扫描器发现的漏洞信息，而非经过验证的漏洞发生率。 排除三个包含大量建议的类别后，后者的比率降至 6.2%。 执行相同任务的运行在测量得分上存在差异，而一次重构后的 ProgramBench 运行则暴露了其首次实现编写时遗留的持续性问题。 一项修复案例研究降低了扫描器信号，同时保留了测试行为，但也揭示了其对等效 API 重写的敏感性。 SDLI 提供了一种同时研究进展与安全发现点的方法。 它在引导智能体以及确认可被利用的漏洞方面的价值仍有待进一步验证。

paragraphs.en: Code reuse can spread the consequences of an insecure design choice across a repository ( Lopes et al. 2017 ; Mojica et al. 2013 ; Prana et al. 2021 ) and through dependencies ( Zerouali et al. 2022 ; Zimmermann et al. 2019 ) . LLM-generated code is susceptible to such choices. Copilot suggestions were vulnerable in roughly 40% of the tested CWE scenarios ( Pearce et al. 2025 ) , and subsequent work examines security in developer assistance and iterative generation ( Sandoval et al. 2023 ; Shukla et al. 2025 ; Schreiber and Tippe 2025 ; Tihanyi et al. 2023 ; Wu et al. 2023 ) . As coding agents reuse their own earlier output, security-relevant decisions can persist through many later changes.
paragraphs.zh: 代码重用可以将不安全设计决策的后果扩散到整个代码库（Lopes 等人，2017；Mojica 等人，2013；Prana 等人，2021），并通过依赖关系进一步传播（Zerouali 等人，2022；Zimmermann 等人，2019）。 LLM 生成的代码容易受到此类决策的影响。 在测试的 CWE 场景中，约 40% 的情况中 Copilot 的建议存在漏洞（Pearce 等人，2025），后续研究则探讨了开发者辅助和迭代生成过程中的安全性问题（Sandoval 等人，2023；Shukla 等人，2025；Schreiber 和 Tippe，2025；Tihanyi 等人，2023；Wu 等人，2023）。 由于编码智能体会重复使用自己早期的输出，与安全相关的决策可能会在后续的多次修改中持续存在。

paragraphs.en: LLM coding agents now write repositories over hundreds or thousands of turns. MirrorCode traces span roughly 12,000 messages ( Adamczewski et al. 2026 ) , SWE-EVO tasks touch 21 files on average ( Le et al. 2025 ) , and NL2Repo-Bench requires at least 181 interaction turns to produce an installable library ( Ding et al. 2025 ) . Recorded actions offer checkpoints that can be scanned before submission. Scanning only the submitted artifact leaves these intermediate states unobserved. Our focus is the coupling of checkpoint findings with measured functional progress.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 编码智能体如今需要数百甚至数千轮交互才能编写出整个代码库。 MirrorCode 的追踪记录涵盖了大约 12,000 条消息（Adamczewski 等人，2026），SWE-EVO 任务平均涉及 21 个文件（Le 等人，2025），而 NL2Repo-Bench 至少需要 181 轮交互才能生成一个可安装的库（Ding 等人，2025）。 记录下来的操作提供了可在提交前进行扫描的检查点。 如果仅扫描已提交的最终产物，这些中间状态将不会被观察到。 我们的重点是检查点发现结果与已测量的功能进展之间的耦合关系。

paragraphs.en: This paper takes a first step toward closing that gap. We formalize trajectory-level security measurement as the Security Debt Line Integral (SDLI), which charges a per-checkpoint risk reading against the functional progress banked at that checkpoint. A risky checkpoint incurs no charge if it does not improve historical-best progress. Charges already accumulated remain even if the code is later removed. We instantiate the risk reading via BBCS, a four-tool SAST oracle named after its constituent tools Bandit, Bearer, CodeQL, and Semgrep, identified as Pareto-optimal for Python by Liu et al. (2026) . Figure 1 shows the pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 本文迈出了填补这一差距的第一步。 我们将轨迹级安全测量形式化为“安全债务线积分”（Security Debt Line Integral，SDLI），该指标在每个检查点处根据当时的功能进展记录收取一次风险读数费用。 如果某个高风险检查点未能提升历史最佳进展，则不产生费用。 即使代码后来被移除，已累积的费用仍然有效。 我们通过 BBCS 实现这一风险读数，BBCS 是一个由四个工具组成的 SAST 预言机，其名称分别源自 Bandit、Bearer、CodeQL 和 Semgrep；Liu 等人（2026）的研究表明，该组合对于 Python 而言是帕累托最优的。 图 1 展示了这一流程。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SDLI on three populations and, throughout the paper, restrict headline analysis to runs whose code actually works. This filter asks whether useful solutions also carry security findings. Findings in unsuccessful runs remain relevant, but answer a different question. The two large populations are 830 passing short-horizon SWE-bench trajectories and, from 712 scanned Python ProgramBench solutions produced by six frontier model configurations, the 80 mostly working ones that pass at least 90% of the official test suite. The 13 public MirrorCode runs, of which 3 reach a recorded pass ratio of 1.0, expose up to 146 scannable checkpoints per run and serve as a focused case study of how debt enters and persists over weeks-scale trajectories. Our goal is to quantify how much security debt agent trajectories accumulate, to understand when and how it enters, and to test whether it can be repaired once a scanner points at it. For the last question we replay a real debt-carrying trajectory at the step where the scanner findings first appeared and hand the scanner’s findings back to a model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个群体上评估 SDLI，并在整篇论文中，将主要分析限制在代码实际能运行的运行实例上。 这一筛选标准旨在判断是否有用的解决方案也同时包含安全问题的发现。 未成功运行中的发现仍然具有相关性，但回答的是另一个问题。 这两个大型群体分别是：830 条通过短期 SWE-bench 测试的轨迹；以及从六个前沿模型配置生成的 712 个已扫描的 Python ProgramBench 解决方案中，选出至少通过官方测试套件 90% 测试的 80 个主要能运行的解决方案。 13 个公开的 MirrorCode 运行实例中，有 3 个达到了记录在案的 1.0 通过率；每个运行实例最多暴露出 146 个可扫描的检查点，并作为一个聚焦案例研究，说明技术债务如何在数周时间跨度的轨迹中产生并持续存在。 我们的目标是量化智能体轨迹会积累多少安全债务，理解其产生和引入的时间与方式，并测试一旦扫描仪指出问题后，这些债务是否能够得到修复。 针对最后一个问题，我们在扫描仪发现首次出现的步骤上重新运行一条实际携带技术债务的轨迹，并将扫描仪的发现结果反馈给模型。

paragraphs.en: We focus on Python because it has established SAST tools and public agent artifacts. Tool choice determines which weakness classes are visible. We adopt Bandit ( PyCQA 2024 ) , Bearer ( Bearer, Inc. 2024 ) , CodeQL ( GitHub 2024 ) , and Semgrep ( Semgrep, Inc. 2024 ) , the BBCS combination studied by Liu et al. (2026) . paragraphs.en: ProgramBench ( Yang et al. 2026 ) asks agents to reimplement whole CLI programs from binaries and documentation, and publishes frontier-model submissions at scale. We scan 712 Python final workspaces from six public submissions 2 2 2 https://github.com/ProgramBench/submissions , with heavy artifacts hosted on Hugging Face. (Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and GPT-5.5 at three reasoning-effort settings), each paired with a full agent trajectory and an official evaluation pass rate. Unlike SWE-bench issue fixes, no scanned ProgramBench run passes 100% of the official hidden tests (the best reaches 99.7%). We therefore take the 80 mostly working runs with G T ≥ 0.90 G_{T}\geq 0.90 as the primary population and use the 24 near-solved runs with G T ≥ 0.95 G_{T}\geq 0.95 as a stricter subset.

paragraphs.en: MirrorCode progress comes from test results recorded in its public transcripts, carried into a historical-best envelope. The 463 available code snapshots provide trajectory measurements, but changing test coverage limits comparability with an independently run fixed suite. Bandit, Bearer, and Semgrep scan each snapshot. CodeQL scans selected checkpoints, with interpolation between them. It reports zero risk throughout the available MirrorCode scans, so interpolation contributes no signal here. The gowsdl replay below reconstructs per-action risk, not an official per-action progress curve.

paragraphs.en: Endpoint interpretation. The endpoint score is not a lower bound on full SDLI. If all progress is achieved at risk 0 and risk appears only afterward, full SDLI is 0 while R T ​ G T > 0 R_{T}G_{T}>0 . Conversely, risk charged during progress may later disappear, giving R T ​ G T = 0 R_{T}G_{T}=0 with positive SDLI. Only the set of findings observed across checkpoints necessarily contains the final set, under the same scan configuration.

paragraphs.en: Scanner configuration. Bandit skips B101, B110, B112, and B401 through B413. Bearer uses its SAST scanner with all severity levels. Semgrep uses p/python , p/security-audit , and p/owasp-top-ten . CodeQL uses the Python security-extended suite, with a configured fallback to query pack 1.3.0. The artifact records the remaining query filters. CWE identifiers are normalized from tool metadata, with an additional Bandit rule mapping. The mapping groups related identifiers, including CWE-78 and CWE-88 into CWE-77, and CWE-23 through CWE-41 into CWE-22. These are analysis groupings, not evidence that two findings describe the same defect. The full mapping and scan commands are in the artifact.

paragraphs.en: Bandit, Bearer, and Semgrep typically take under 10 seconds each per snapshot in our runs. CodeQL takes roughly two to five minutes. These are observed scan times, not an end-to-end overhead study. We have not measured sensitivity to checkpoint frequency, weights, or ruleset revisions. Remote registry configurations were not all pinned to immutable revisions, which limits exact rescanning.

paragraphs.en: On SWE-bench, 3.9% of the selected test-passing runs contain findings with two-tool class agreement, and the recall-favoring union reading raises the rate to 14.9%. These are issue-fixing tasks in existing projects. We do not establish whether the flagged code was introduced by the agent. The dominant two-tool-reported classes are CWE-502 (insecure deserialization, 18 runs) and CWE-327 (weak crypto, 10 runs). The union adds a single-tool tail led by CWE-22 path handling (46 runs) and CWE-94 code injection (23 runs). The observed findings show that test success can coexist with a non-zero scanner reading.

paragraphs.en: Table 3 shows how much runs on the same task vary. On pypa/hatch-422 , eight of nine runs bank an agree2 SDLI of 3.0 through the same pickle deserialization pattern (CWE-502) while one sibling has a zero score. paragraphs.en: Debt versus functional completeness. Figure 2 (right) tracks what happens as the functional bar rises, and the result complicates a simple “long horizon means more debt” story. Under the headline agree2 oracle, prevalence falls from 34.6% across all 712 scanned finals to 26.2% in the 80 runs above 90% pass rate and to 4.2% (a single run) among the 24 near-solved runs above 95%, with mean agree2 SDLI falling to 0.12. The agree2 prevalence declines across these nested subsets. Their changing task and model composition prevents a causal interpretation. The union reading shows no such gradient (81.0%, 82.5%, 83.3%), which is consistent with broad capability advisories remaining active across the subsets. The working tier’s mean is pulled above the population’s by the gowsdl case study below. Two readings are consistent with the agree2 gradient and our data cannot separate them. Lower scanner readings may accompany higher test performance, or the tier may reflect its composition, since 17 of its 24 runs come from one configuration (GPT-5.5 xhigh). What the gradient does not do is reach zero. One near-solved run still carries two-tool class agreement, and the MirrorCode gotree run reaching recorded progress 1.0 below carries the largest per-run score in its benchmark, so high recorded progress does not imply a zero scanner score.

paragraphs.en: On channel composition, Bandit and Bearer carry most of the union signal, Semgrep overlaps with some of these class-level findings, and CodeQL contributes findings on only 66 of the 712 finals and 6 of the 80 working runs. One practical note for anyone replaying this pipeline. Three of the four channels can silently report zero findings for purely environmental reasons. Semgrep and CodeQL skip symlinked directories, and Bearer skips any file that is gitignored in an enclosing repository, which includes scan workspaces stored under a repo’s ignored output directory. Earlier passes of this corpus lost the Semgrep and CodeQL channels to the symlinks and the Bearer channel to the gitignore rule before per-file spot checks caught both, so we recommend planting a known-vulnerable canary file and verifying that every channel reports it before trusting any zero.

paragraphs.en: MirrorCode ( Adamczewski et al. 2026 ) anchors the weeks-scale end. Of its 13 public Python trajectories, 3 reach a recorded pass ratio of 1.0, the cal and choose runs and the gotree run by Claude Opus 4.6. Two of the three have zero scores under both channels. The third, by far the largest of the three reimplementations at 7,810 lines, banks an agree2 SDLI of 3.000 and a union SDLI of 7.014, the highest per-run debt in its benchmark. This run combines high recorded progress with persistent scanner findings. Across the wider context population of all 13 runs, seven carry two-tool class agreement and ten accumulate non-zero BBCS-union SDLI, and six of ten gotree attempts across two Opus versions contain the same flagged XML parsing pattern, using xml.etree.ElementTree instead of defusedxml (CWE-611). Sibling trajectories on the same task have lower readings, although their functional outcomes differ. Four of the ten gotree attempts hold zero agree2 risk across every checkpoint, one of them through all 24 checkpoints of a half-successful attempt, while sibling runs have non-zero readings.

paragraphs.en: The scale results describe endpoint scanner prevalence. Recorded intermediate states reveal when findings appear and whether they persist. ProgramBench does not publish intermediate code checkpoints, but its public trajectories record every shell command the agent ran, and that turns out to be enough. In the run we study here the agent creates its implementation file with a single heredoc write and afterwards modifies it only through small self-contained text edits and sed one-liners. Replaying those write and edit operations in a sandbox reconstructs the exact state of the file after every agent action, indexed in execution order, and we validate the reconstruction by checking that the replayed final file is byte for byte identical to the published final workspace. For this run, reconstruction adds a per-action risk curve to the endpoint score. Following the original analysis, we carry the last valid reading through temporary syntax errors, so those states are not independent measurements. The official pass ratio is still available only at the end.

It probes the reference executable, catalogs flags, renders sample services, and diffs outputs. At action 63 it writes the entire 1,296-line implementation in one shot, and that single write already carries every CWE class any scanner ever reports on this run. The reports concern a TLS verification bypass behind the tool’s -i flag (CWE-295), xml.etree parsing (CWE-611, CWE-20), URL and file-path handling (CWE-22), and a gofmt subprocess call (CWE-77). These rule labels do not establish exploitability. The remaining 53 actions are pure functional refinement. The agent nudges type naming, documentation placement, and edge cases in small verified steps until its own comparison harness passes all 11 bundled services, and the official evaluation lands at 90.5%. Three of the four scanners report overlapping CWE classes. Bandit reports all five classes at medium severity and below, Bearer also flags the TLS bypass and rates the path handling and the subprocess call high, Semgrep independently flags the TLS bypass and the XML parsing at high severity and adds a dynamic-URL audit signal (CWE-939), while CodeQL reports nothing on this file. Across all of those actions the risk reading never moves. The union R t R_{t} steps from 0 to 14.0 at action 63, the agree2 reading to 12.0, and both stay there to the end of the run.

paragraphs.en: Fidelity pressure and the scanner signal. The most telling finding is the TLS bypass. The original gowsdl exposes a -i flag that skips certificate verification, so the agent faithfully recreates it using ssl._create_unverified_context , and three independent scanners flag exactly that idiom. paragraphs.en: RQ3 says the entry step is observable. RQ4 asks what happens if we act on it. We rewind the gowsdl trajectory to action 63, the first action with scanner findings, and hand the freshly written file to a repair model together with security feedback. The original agent is not available to us, so Gemini 3.1 Pro plays the repairer, and the repair is delivered as exact search and replace edit blocks, the way coding agents actually edit files. Suppressing the scanner is forbidden and does not help, since we strip nosec comments before re-scanning. We compare four feedback arms. The exact findings with rule, CWE, line, and message, or only the sentence that a scanner flagged the file, each as a single attempt and as a retry loop of up to five rounds. Every candidate is verified four ways, a fresh scan, a compile check, byte-level comparison of the generated Go output on all 11 bundled services, and a replay of the agent’s 18 later edits on top of the fix. Table 4 summarizes the arms. Full prompts and candidate files are in the artifact.

sents.en: The exact findings with rule, CWE, line, and message, or only the sentence that a scanner flagged the file, each as a single attempt and as a retry loop of up to five rounds.
sents.zh: 这些方案包括：包含规则、CWE、行号和消息的具体发现结果，或仅包含扫描器标记文件的相关句子；每种方案均作为单次尝试和最多五轮的重试循环进行测试。

sents.en: Every candidate is verified four ways, a fresh scan, a compile check, byte-level comparison of the generated Go output on all 11 bundled services, and a replay of the agent’s 18 later edits on top of the fix.
sents.zh: 每个候选方案都通过四种方式验证：一次新的扫描、一次编译检查、对在所有11个捆绑服务上生成的Go输出进行字节级比较，以及将智能体后续18次编辑重新应用于修复结果上进行验证。

sents.zh: 表4总结了这些方案。

paragraphs.en: Precise feedback reduces the scanner signal. With exact findings, the single-attempt arm changed the parser to defusedxml , added an http/https URL-scheme allowlist, and replaced the TLS context construction. It retained certificate-verification bypass under -i , as the prompt required. Thus the changed TLS idiom should not be described as removing that capability. The generated Go output remained byte-identical on 11 local services, and all 18 later edits replayed successfully. These checks establish local behavioral compatibility, not security against adversarial inputs or equivalent hidden-test performance.
paragraphs.zh: 精确的反馈会减弱扫描器信号。 借助准确的发现结果，单次尝试分支将解析器更改为 defusedxml，添加了一个 http/https URL 方案允许列表，并替换了 TLS 上下文构建方式。 正如提示所要求的那样，它在 -i 参数下保留了证书验证绕过功能。 因此，不应将更改后的 TLS 表述描述为移除了该功能。 在 11 个本地服务上，生成的 Go 输出保持字节完全一致，并且后续所有 18 次编辑均成功重放。 这些检查确立了本地行为兼容性，而非针对对抗性输入的安全性或等效的隐藏测试表现。

paragraphs.en: The scanner can be satisfied without being right. In this case, 16 of the 21 initial findings belong to the advisory-heavy classes CWE-22, CWE-77, and CWE-939. These reports flag operations that may be legitimate for a CLI tool and need contextual review. We do not treat every finding in these classes as harmless, or assume behavior-preserving repair is impossible.
paragraphs.zh: 扫描器可以在不正确的情况下仍然感到满意。 在这种情况下，最初发现的 21 个问题中有 16 个属于建议密集类 CWE-22、CWE-77 和 CWE-939。 这些报告会标记出可能对 CLI 工具来说是合法操作的行为，并需要结合上下文进行审查。 我们并不将这些类别中的每一个发现都视为无害的，也不认为保持原有行为的修复是不可能的。

paragraphs.en: The precise-feedback candidate routed fetching through build_opener().open() , after which some Bandit and Semgrep matches disappeared. The measured union reading fell to 3.25 even though the relevant fetching capability remained. Bearer still flagged path handling. For the illustrative repaired branch in Figure 3 , we retain the three advisory classes at their original weights, yielding 7.0. This adjusted reading is an explicit accounting choice, not a measured post-repair scanner score or a lower bound on true risk. Multiple tools exposed this mismatch, but tool agreement alone cannot validate a repair.

paragraphs.en: RQ4. This single case demonstrates edits that reduce scanner findings while preserving tested local behavior. It also shows that an equivalent API rewrite can lower a score without removing a security-relevant capability. Exploit validation and broader repair trials are needed before claiming reliable vulnerability repair.
paragraphs.zh: RQ4. 这个单一案例展示了能够减少扫描结果，同时保留所测试的本地行为的修改。 它还表明，对 API 进行等效的重写可能会降低评分，而无需移除与安全相关的能力。 在宣称实现了可靠的漏洞修复之前，还需要进行漏洞利用验证和更广泛的修复试验。

paragraphs.en: The gowsdl replay locates persistent findings at action 63, before the remaining 53 actions of functional refinement. A final-state scan would detect these same classes. The demonstrated benefit is earlier visibility and localization to an implementation action, not additional detection coverage. Our large-population scores are themselves endpoint readings and cannot establish an advantage over final-only scanning. We have not quantified transient findings missed at the endpoint, compared early and late repair cost, or tested whether earlier feedback improves repair success.
paragraphs.zh: gowsdl 重播在动作 63 处定位到了持续存在的发现，而功能优化还有剩余的 53 个动作。 最终状态扫描也会检测到这些相同的类别。 所展示的优势在于更早地识别并定位到实现动作，而非增加了检测覆盖范围。 我们的大规模群体得分本身是终点的读数，无法证明其比仅进行最终扫描更具优势。 我们尚未量化在终点处被遗漏的暂时性发现，也未比较早期和晚期修复的成本，或测试更早的反馈是否能提高修复成功率。

paragraphs.en: We see three possible uses for SDLI, each requiring further evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们看到 SDLI 有三种可能的用途，每种都需要进一步评估。

paragraphs.en: In-line risk gauge in agentic IDEs. SDLI can be surfaced alongside the existing test-pass gauge in tools like Cursor, Windsurf, and Copilot Workspace. The lightweight Bandit, Bearer, and Semgrep scans at each checkpoint complete in seconds, fast enough for real-time feedback, and agree2 excludes classes reported by only one tool. When R t R_{t} rises, the IDE can warn the developer before the agent commits further to a risky architectural path.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体 IDE 中的内联风险指标。 在 Cursor、Windsurf 和 Copilot Workspace 等工具中，SDLI 可以与现有的测试通过指标一同显示。 在每个检查点处，轻量级的 Bandit、Bearer 和 Semgrep 扫描可在数秒内完成，足以实现实时反馈；此外，agree2 会排除仅由一个工具报告的类。 当 R t R_{t} 上升时，IDE 可以在智能体进一步提交到有风险的建筑路径之前向开发者发出警告。

paragraphs.en: Stop-condition for autonomous agent loops. A monitoring policy could pause an agent when current risk rises or cumulative SDLI exceeds a budget. Current risk must be checked separately because SDLI ignores increases after progress plateaus. Our case study identifies a possible intervention point, without establishing optimal timing. This is especially relevant for long-running autonomous agents where human oversight is deferred ( Takerngsaksiri et al. 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 自主智能体循环的停止条件。 当当前风险上升或累积 SDLI 超过预算时，监控策略可以暂停智能体。 必须单独检查当前风险，因为 SDLI 会忽略进展停滞后的增长。 我们的案例研究确定了一个可能的干预点，但并未明确最佳时机。 对于长期运行的自主智能体而言，这一点尤为重要，因为其中的人类监督已被推迟（Takerngsaksiri 等人，2025）。

sents.zh: 自主智能体循环的停止条件。

sents.zh: 当当前风险上升或累积 SDLI 超过预算时，监控策略可以暂停智能体。

paragraphs.en: Reward-shaping signal for agent post-training. The same-task variation in Table 3 motivates testing whether validated lower-risk alternatives can inform preference-based training. SDLI as a per-step penalty ( R t ⋅ Δ ​ G t R_{t}\cdot\Delta G_{t} ) can shape agent policy through reinforcement or preference-based learning ( Schulman et al. 2017 ; Rafailov et al. 2023 ; Hong et al. 2024 ) , but we have not tested such training. Rewards based only on scanner readings may favor detector evasion.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体训练后的奖励塑造信号。 表3中同一任务的变体促使我们测试：经过验证的较低风险替代方案是否能为基于偏好的训练提供指导。 将SDLI作为每一步的惩罚项（ R t ⋅ Δ ​ G t R_{t}\cdot\Delta G_{t} ），可以通过强化学习或基于偏好的学习来塑造智能体的策略（Schulman et al. 2017；Rafailov et al. 2023；Hong et al. 2024），但我们尚未测试这种训练方法。 仅基于扫描仪读数的奖励可能会鼓励探测器规避行为。

paragraphs.en: Broader intervention studies should cover multiple tasks and repair models, building on self-refinement work ( Shinn et al. 2023 ; Madaan et al. 2023 ; Chen et al. 2023 ; He and Vechev 2023 ) . Replaying additional ProgramBench runs would provide risk traces, but full SDLI also requires reliable intermediate progress. Other priorities are extending language coverage and evaluating human review of advisory findings at their point of entry.
paragraphs.zh: 更广泛的干预研究应涵盖多种任务和修复模型，并在此基础上拓展自我优化工作（Shinn 等人，2023；Madaan 等人，2023；Chen 等人，2023；He 和 Vechev，2023）。 重新运行额外的 ProgramBench 实例可以提供风险轨迹，但完整的 SDLI 还需要可靠的中间进展。 其他优先事项包括扩展语言覆盖范围，以及在建议结果进入系统时评估人工审查的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Validity and attribution. We have not performed a stratified manual validation or exploit-based assessment of the population findings. Two tools may report different sites within one class, and our grouping ignores multiplicity. The reported rates therefore concern SAST findings. We did not fingerprint findings against initial repositories or classify them as pre-existing, introduced, resolved, or reintroduced. SWE-bench findings may predate the agent, and transcript extraction can omit code needed to assess a flow. These limitations prevent attributing the measured risk to agent changes.
paragraphs.zh: 有效性与归因。 我们尚未对总体发现进行分层手动验证或基于漏洞的评估。 两种工具可能在同一类别中报告不同的位置，而我们的分组忽略了多重性。 因此，所报告的比率涉及 SAST 的发现。 我们未将发现与初始存储库进行指纹比对，也未将其分类为预先存在、新引入、已解决或重新引入的。 SWE-bench 的发现可能早于智能体，且转录提取可能遗漏评估流程所需的代码。 这些限制使得无法将测得的风险归因于智能体的变化。

paragraphs.en: Coverage and comparability. The oracle covers Python, and its output depends on rules, weights, and scan scope. Advisory-heavy classes affect both union and agree2. The large populations use endpoint scores, while MirrorCode has heterogeneous checkpoints and recorded progress proxies. Missing intermediate states can hide both entry and removal. We have not evaluated checkpoint-frequency sensitivity or total monitoring overhead. Repeated runs share tasks and models, so the rates describe these selected artifacts rather than independent samples of deployments. The three-run MirrorCode working subset is too small for a stable population estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 覆盖范围与可比性。 该预言机覆盖 Python，其输出取决于规则、权重和扫描范围。 以建议为主的类别会影响 union 和 agree2。 大规模群体使用端点分数，而 MirrorCode 具有异构的检查点和记录进度代理。 缺失的中间状态可能掩盖进入和移除两种情况。 我们尚未评估检查点频率的敏感性或总监控开销。 重复运行共享任务和模型，因此这些比率描述的是这些选定的产物，而非部署的独立样本。 三次运行的 MirrorCode 工作子集过小，无法得出稳定的群体估计值。

paragraphs.en: Intervention evidence. The gowsdl run was selected for its high score. Its repair uses one model, with compatibility checked on 11 bundled services rather than the official hidden tests. Retaining -i preserves a TLS bypass, and fewer scanner matches do not prove fewer exploitable defects. The experiment demonstrates feasibility of localized feedback and edits, without establishing reliable steering, general repair success, or a cost advantage over endpoint repair.
paragraphs.zh: 干预证据。 gowsdl 运行因其高分而被选中。 其修复使用一个模型，兼容性通过 11 个捆绑服务进行验证，而非官方隐藏的测试。 保留 -i 可维持 TLS 绕过机制，而扫描器匹配数量较少并不能证明可利用的缺陷更少。 该实验证明了局部反馈和编辑的可行性，但并未确立可靠的引导机制、修复的整体成功率，或相较于端点修复的成本优势。

paragraphs.en: We introduced SDLI to couple scanner readings with increases in historical-best functional progress. Endpoint measurements show that working solutions can carry SAST findings, while MirrorCode and a reconstructed ProgramBench case expose their persistence over recorded states. Same-task variation motivates studying lower-risk alternatives, but does not establish steerability. The repair case preserves tested local behavior while reducing scanner readings, and also exposes how equivalent code can evade pattern matching. Validating findings, attributing them to changes, and comparing checkpoint intervention with final-state scanning remain necessary steps toward a security metric with stronger operational meaning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们引入了 SDLI，将扫描结果与历史最佳功能进展的提升相结合。 端点测量表明，有效解决方案可以承载 SAST 的发现结果，而 MirrorCode 和重构后的 ProgramBench 案例则揭示了它们在记录状态中的持久性。 同一任务的变体促使我们研究风险更低的替代方案，但并未证明其可引导性。 修复案例在保持已测试的局部行为的同时减少了扫描结果，同时也揭示了等效代码如何规避模式匹配。 验证发现、将其归因于变化，并将检查点干预与最终状态扫描进行比较，仍然是迈向具有更强操作意义的安全指标的必要步骤。
